name: c7b
root_cause: deploy-4822 (prompt triage_planner v14) tells the planner to re-call the search tool with a broader query until results are found; sparse tenants return no results, so the graph cycles planner<->search_kb until GraphRecursionError at 25 steps, burning ~15x tokens. Checkpoint write slowness is a symptom.
title: LangGraph recursion loop
